sermon.title: Jesus Christ Taught with Authority— April 24, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Jesus taught with authority and backed His words with power. The Beatitudes show how to approach God and possess the kingdom: poor in spirit, hungry for righteousness, meek like Moses, merciful and glad in persecution.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Message begins at 33:42 after worship.

faqs.question: What did the crowd come to hear?
Can flesh and blood inherit the kingdom?
On whom does God look?
faqs.answer: The poor and contrite who tremble at His word.

faqs.question: Why did the widow come to the temple?
faqs.answer: To give and worship, not to get.

faqs.question: What is the kingdom of God?
faqs.answer: Righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Ghost.
